stem.text: A mobile phone battery is charged by connecting it to a constant potential difference of $5.0\,\text{V}$. After a time of $1.0\,\text{hour}$, the initial current of $0.50\,\text{A}$ slowly decreases to zero, as shown.

stem.alt: Graph of current in amperes against time in hours. The current is constant at 0.5 from 0 to 1.0 hours, then decreases in a straight line to zero at 2.0 hours.

stem.text: What is the best estimate of the energy transferred to the battery during the time of $2.0\,\text{hours}$ shown in the graph?
